narrative.overview: Esta looks like a well-run banking app crossed with a clean property listing: a cool light-gray ground, white cards with a hairline border and one soft shadow, one lacquer-red accent, one sans typeface, line icons beside every label, and real photos of the places.
keyCharacteristics: White cards on a gray ground. No card inside a card.
One accent for the primary action, the active navigation item and the brand mark.
Icons beside labels, never instead of them on mobile.
Photos for places, initials for people.
Light by default whatever the device says; dark only when the member chooses it.

rules.name: The Proven Pair Rule
rules.body: Every foreground and background pair the UI draws is listed in text-pairs.ts and measured by pnpm contrast:check in both themes.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: The accent marks the one primary action on a screen and where you are. Secondary actions are ink or outline.

rules.name: The Figures Rule
rules.body: Amounts use the figures utility and sit right-aligned in tables. Summary cards use the compact money form; tables and forms use the exact amount.

rules.name: The Full Coverage Rule
rules.body: pnpm glyphs:check reads every shipped font file at every weight in typefaces and fails on any miss or a missing tnum.

rules.name: The Leading Rule
rules.body: Line height stays at 1.3 or more, so Vietnamese stacked marks clear the line above. pnpm check fails on any token below 1.3.

rules.name: The Self-Hosted Rule
rules.body: Never Arial, Roboto or a system face as the identity face, and never a font CDN. Inter is self-hosted and chosen by Ryan (2026-10-24).

dos: Do set every color from a token (bg-surface, text-ink, var(--due)), and add a new pairing to text-pairs.ts before it ships.
Do wrap content in a card on the ground, with structure inside from rules and spacing.
Do put an icon beside every navigation item and primary action, with its text label.
Do show status as shape, word, then color, in a pill on its -fill.
Do run pnpm tokens:build after editing tokens.ts and commit the generated tokens.css.
donts: Don't use pure black, pure white, gradient washes, glass or neon.
Don't nest cards or put icon tiles above headings.
Don't set gray text on a colored background.
Don't use more than one accent, or the accent as a status.
Don't show a button, search field or bell for a feature that does not exist yet.
Don't use emoji, sparkle or magic-wand icons for the assistant.
